## ♿ Accessibility Issue

This project is committed to WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance. Please help us improve accessibility.

## 📝 Issue Description

A clear and concise description of the accessibility issue.

## 🎯 WCAG Criteria

Which WCAG 2.2 criterion is affected?
- [ ] 1. Perceivable
- [ ] 2. Operable
- [ ] 3. Understandable
- [ ] 4. Robust

**Specific Criterion**: [e.g., 2.1.1 Keyboard]

## 📍 Where to Find It

URL or component path where the issue occurs:

## 🛠️ Testing Method

How was this issue discovered?
- [ ] Screen reader (which one: NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, etc.)
- [ ] Keyboard navigation
- [ ] Browser accessibility inspector
- [ ] Color contrast checker
- [ ] Automated tool
- [ ] Manual inspection
- [ ] Other: ___

## 🖥️ Environment

- **OS**: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14.5]
- **Assistive Technology**: [e.g. NVDA 2024.1, JAWS 2024, VoiceOver]
- **Browser**: [e.g. Firefox 121, Chrome 120]

## 🎥 Steps to Reproduce

1. Open the application
2. Navigate to [component/page]
3. Use [assistive technology]
4. Observe the issue

## 🎯 Expected Behavior

What should happen for accessibility compliance?

## 😕 Actual Behavior

What currently happens?

## 📸 Screenshots/Recording

If applicable, attach screenshots or a recording showing the issue.

## 🔍 Impact

How does this issue affect users?
- [ ] Critical - blocks access to core functionality
- [ ] High - significantly impacts usability
- [ ] Medium - causes inconvenience
- [ ] Low - minor accessibility improvement

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have verified this affects accessibility
- [ ] I have provided environment details
- [ ] I have included reproduction steps
- [ ] I have identified the WCAG criterion
